sentence: In the same panel, AI investment alone stays insignificant while its interaction with R&D turns significantly positive
passage: [Banna & Alam (2025), sec. 4.1] "the interaction term [ ] exhibits a positive and statistically significant effect, indicating that the combination of AI adoption and R&D activity produces complementary and mutually reinforcing effects on firm performance."

gemini.note: The passage confirms that the interaction term is positive and statistically significant, but it omits any mention of AI investment alone staying insignificant.
